features.title: Optimization Opportunity Identification
features.description: Identify and highlight opportunities for optimizing pipeline performance.
acceptance_criteria: The system suggests optimization strategies based on data analysis.
Users receive alerts for critical optimization opportunities.
Recommendations are based on historical performance data.

features.title: Execution Metrics Evaluation
features.description: Create a system to evaluate execution metrics from the pipeline data.
acceptance_criteria: Metrics are accurately calculated from the loaded data.
The system can handle large datasets efficiently.
Users can view a summary of key metrics.

features.title: Data Loading Module
features.description: Develop a module to load pipeline execution data for analysis.
acceptance_criteria: The module can import data from various sources.
Data integrity is maintained during the loading process.
The module provides error handling for data import failures.

features.title: Statistical Summary Generation
features.description: Implement functionality to generate detailed statistical summaries of pipeline data.
acceptance_criteria: Summaries include mean, median, standard deviation, and other relevant statistics.
Users can customize the parameters for statistical analysis.
The system provides downloadable reports of the statistical summaries.

features.title: Visual Representation of Data
features.description: Develop visual tools to represent pipeline data and metrics.
acceptance_criteria: Visualizations are generated based on user-selected metrics.
Charts and graphs are interactive and user-friendly.
Users can export visualizations in common formats (e.g., PNG, PDF).
